Here, beginIndex is 0 (non-negative), endIndex is indexOfSlash which is guaranteed to be >=0 and < string length because '/' was found, and beginIndex (0) is not greater than endIndex (>=0). Therefore, all conditions that could throw IndexOutOfBoundsException are avoided by the prior checks.
